Drummer Sonny Igoe was born in Jersey City, New Jersey on October 8, 1923.

After service in the Marine Corps, he toured with Les Elgart and Ina Ray Hutton, and was a member of Woody Herman’s Third Herd. Sonny worked in the New York City recording studios during the 1960s and is now a respected percussion teacher.
Sonny was interviewed at his home in Emerson, New Jersey on July 31, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
